claim: Multi-AZ is enabled by default on Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) clusters, but ElastiCache automatically enables Multi-AZ only if the cluster contains at least one replica in a different Availability Zone from the primary in all shards.

values.display: at least one replica in a different Availability Zone from the primary in all shards

qualifiers.scope: Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) clusters
qualifiers.condition: only if every shard has at least one replica in a different Availability Zone from the primary

evidence.quote: Multi-AZ is enabled by default on Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) clusters.
ElastiCache will automatically enable Multi-AZ only if the cluster contains at least one replica in a different Availability Zone from the primary in all shards.
